provider.name: Key Biodiversity Areas
provider.organization_type: global biodiversity-site standard, identification, proposal, review, geospatial, trigger-feature, data, planning, policy, and partnership infrastructure
provider.description: Key Biodiversity Areas are sites contributing significantly to the global persistence of biodiversity. The KBA Partnership maintains the Global Standard for identifying KBAs, quantitative criteria and thresholds, proposal and review processes, national coordination mechanisms, site and trigger records, geospatial boundaries, public maps and downloads, training, policy guidance, and links to protected-area, species, ecosystem, and business-planning systems.
institutional_context: BirdLife International and the KBA Secretariat
International Union for Conservation of Nature and its commissions
National KBA coordination groups, conservation organizations, data providers, and rights holders

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting KBA documentation, standards, criteria, thresholds, proposals, reviews, national processes, training, site records, trigger features, boundaries, maps, downloads, APIs, identifiers, data schemas, integrations, business guidance, licenses, citations, governance, partner institutions, and related biodiversity frameworks.
purpose.authoritative_notice: The KBA Partnership, current KBA Standard and guidance, official KBA data releases, national coordination groups, review bodies, partner institutions, source datasets, and cited publications remain authoritative for site status, criteria, thresholds, boundaries, trigger features, versions, legal conditions, and contacts.
